heroSummary: All District 196 students start Monday, August 30, 2027. There is no school Friday, September 3 or Monday, September 6, creating a four-day Labor Day weekend. MEA Break is October 21–22, Winter Break runs December 22–31, Spring Break runs March 27–31, and the last student day is June 7, 2028. Most schools use trimesters; Eastview High School uses quarters.

calendarNotes: This page covers District 196’s districtwide 2027–28 academic calendar. No-school dates may be districtwide or apply only to K–8 or grades 9–12, so families should check the scope printed for each date. Most schools use trimesters; Eastview High School uses quarters. School-specific events, activities, and fine-arts dates are maintained on each school’s calendar.

customSections.label: What Changed for 2027–28
customSections.content: Several dates shift from the 2026–27 calendar.

groups.label: Changes families may notice
items: School starts one day earlier, on August 30, and ends two days earlier, on June 7.
MEA Break moves to October 21–22, while the March staff data-analysis day moves to March 17.
Spring Break moves to March 27–31. Most schools continue to use trimesters, while Eastview High School continues on quarters.

customSections.label: Source Note: Different Winter Break Dates in District 196 Sources
customSections.content: District 196’s approved 2027–28 PDF and current academic-calendar page list Winter Break as December 22–31. The district’s December 2025 calendar-approval article describes it as December 23–January 2. This page follows the approved PDF and current calendar page.

customSections.label: Source Note: April 21 Has No Published Reason
customSections.content: The approved PDF lists April 21 simply as “No School” for K–12. The live district page also lists the date without a reason, and the Board approval article identifies it as a no-school day for students and staff. District 196 does not state a reason, so this page does not assign one.

customSections.label: Translation Availability
customSections.content: District 196 currently lists only an English printable calendar for 2027–28. Spanish and Somali PDFs are available for 2026–27 but were not listed for 2027–28 when this page was reviewed.

calendarFaqs.q: When does District 196 start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: All students start Monday, August 30, 2027. The approved calendar does not print separate first days by grade.

calendarFaqs.q: When is District 196 MEA break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: MEA Break is a districtwide no-school period on Thursday and Friday, October 21–22, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is District 196 Winter Break in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The approved PDF and current district calendar page list Winter Break as December 22 through December 31, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is District 196 Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 27 through March 31, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: Which District 196 conference days are no-school days?
calendarFaqs.a: October 8 applies to grades 9–12. November 4 and February 3 apply to K–8. November 5, January 21, and February 4 are districtwide no-school days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of District 196 school in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Wednesday, June 7, 2028. June 8 is a teacher grading day after the last student day.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Eastview High School use District 196 trimesters?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Eastview High School uses four quarters with dates printed separately from the district's three general trimesters.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 12, 2026, using District 196’s approved 2027–28 calendar, current academic-calendar page, and calendar-approval article.
sourceReviewDetails: Confirmed the first and last student days, breaks, approved-PDF K–12/K–8/9–12 no-school labels, the live page’s K–12+ terminology, trimesters, and Eastview High School quarter dates.

Compared the approved PDF and current calendar page with the December 2025 Board approval article. The PDF and current page are used for Winter Break because the article publishes a different date range.
The live district page labels June 7 as Monday; the approved PDF calendar and Board article confirm that June 7, 2028 falls on Wednesday.
Checked April 21 across the approved PDF, live calendar page, and Board article. The district does not publish a reason for the closure, so none is assigned here.
No Spanish or Somali 2027–28 printable calendar was listed when this page was reviewed. The calendar may change after publication; school-specific events remain on each school’s calendar.
